mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM stays above 27 for four weeks, signaling continued home provisioning that displaces discretionary retail trips, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains above 25 for all next four weeks and RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The WORKPLACES series rebounded from -32.6 to -6.4, crossing above -10; this office-return threshold will restore weekday foot traffic and push RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -10 after a week below -30
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES = -32.6 at t-1w and -6.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays above -10 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not higher than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in TRANSIT and PARKS above their recent lows indicates broader reopening; the interaction of transit and outdoor mobility will lift RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -17.3 at t-3w to -4.6 at t-1w and TRANSIT is -10.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT improves above -10 and PARKS stays above -20 while RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, RESIDENTIAL above 6 and WORKPLACES below -5 signal stay-home orders that reduce retail trips, so RETAIL_REC will fall over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL = 6.7 at t-0w and WORKPLACES = -6.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL > 6.5 and WORKPLACES < -5 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is higher than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS crossing above -10 reflects restored outdoor recreation; the behavioral spillover from park visits to nearby retail will raise RETAIL_REC within one week.
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above -10 for one week and RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-28-day mean within the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal April grocery and pharmacy demand keeps GROCERY_PHARM above 27, diverting household spending and time away from retail, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM averages 29.75 over the four snapshot weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains above 27 for four weeks and RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT below -10 and WORKPLACES below -6 together indicate ongoing capacity limits on commuting; this policy regime suppresses retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC will decline over two weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT < -10 and WORKPLACES < -6 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is higher than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL falling below 7 signals residents leaving home more often; this mobility shift will increase discretionary retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below 7.0 for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is not higher than last-28-day mean.
